name: Cyber ​​Detox
source:
Cyber ​​Detox is a visual novel where you will face the dangers of the internet and explore its most hidden alleys.

You will meet the inhabitants of this world and they will share their experiences with you as you seek to free yourself from the technological clutches of the web.

[Translated from [url=https://cyberdetoxgame.itch.io/cyber-detox]Itch.io[/url]]
